_note: Computed, never typed. These are the same EPA SDWIS counts the 2026-09-20 deck narrated, reused here so the reference draws a real record rather than a made up one. The point of this directory is the step from a value to a geometry, and that step is identical whatever the value means.

active_systems.set_counted: active community water systems in Texas, EPA SDWIS WATER_SYSTEM, PRIMACY_AGENCY_CODE TX, PWS_ACTIVITY_CODE A, PWS_TYPE_CODE CWS

small_systems.set_counted: the same filters plus POPULATION_SERVED_COUNT less than 3301

large_systems.set_counted: the same filters plus POPULATION_SERVED_COUNT more than 50000
